catches: Referrer-only: the $75 credit goes on the referring customer's next internet bill; no stated reward for the friend

Referral card or form must be returned within 30 days of the new install — credit cannot be given after the fact
Credit to the account can take up to 60 days to process; program can be changed or discontinued at any time
